title: Function workflow
description: One recurring piece of a function's work, at packages/naive/src/functions/<id>/workflows/<workflow id>.json: what starts it, the steps the function's agent takes, the records each step writes through the router, the decision classes a step may raise, and the done criteria in the handoff's form (handoff.schema.json done_criteria), so a workflow run can be handed off and verified like any other work. Every route a step writes must be in the function's write reach, and every class it raises must have a row in the function's decisions.json (packages/naive/src/checks/check-functions.ts).

kind.description: intake: once, when the function joins a venture, and again when its records are missing. schedule: on a cadence. event: when a route is written. request: when a lead or person hands it off.

route.description: For event: the route pattern whose write starts it.

reads.description: Route patterns the agent reads first.

do.description: What the agent does, in one plain sentence.

skill.description: A skill in the function's skills/ folder to load for this step.

ask.description: True when the step asks the person, because only they know the answer.

raises.description: Decision classes this step may raise.
